description:
This story starts from the question of the possibility of friendship between men and women, namely, female friends and male friends. There is often controversy in society about how far the scope of female and male friends can be recognized. Some argue that friendship can be established beyond gender, saying, "You can even take a bath together," while others say, "It's okay to have a drink or a meal together," and think that we should be cautious about intimacy beyond that. However, it is difficult to say that friendship between men and women can be maintained even in such extreme situations.
